req.intro: Documents a record type must have before a status move, per company: a missing one blocks the move or only warns. Each record shows what it still needs in its Files panel, before anyone tries the move.
req.feeds: A rule is switched off, never deleted. The first status moves that ask these rules are the supplier documents and the ship notice; until then each record shows what it needs in its Files panel.

empty.title: No required documents yet
empty.body: Add a rule: for example a supplier certificate before a purchase order is confirmed.
empty.bodyOff_one: Only {count} switched-off rule: tick "Show switched off" to see it.
empty.bodyOff_other: Only {count} switched-off rules: tick "Show switched off" to see them.

dialog.title: New required document
dialog.intro: The record cannot move to the status (or is warned) while no valid document of this kind is on it or on its customer or supplier.
dialog.statusHint: The status the record moves to.
dialog.roleHint: Only records whose customer or supplier has this role, or every record.
dialog.blockHint: The move is refused until the document is on file and valid.
dialog.warnHint: The move goes on; the missing document is said.

held.noRight: You need the right to change the required documents.
held.pickCompany: Pick a company first: a rule belongs to one company.
held.status: Pick a status of this record type.
held.duplicate: An active rule already asks for this document before this status: change that rule.
held.allOn: The ticked rules are already on.
held.allOff: The ticked rules are already off.

problem.conflict: Someone changed this rule meanwhile: the rules were read again.

done.level: Saved: what a missing document does.
